visual_brief: China Zun has silver-blue glass, strong vertical ribs, a narrow waist, a flared base and a broad concave crown. Elevated and three-quarter CBD views best reveal its vase-like silhouette. Distinguish it from Beijing’s straight-sided China World Trade Center towers, the angular CCTV headquarters and Hong Kong’s unrelated CITIC Tower.
notes: Six distinct photographs downloaded, decoded, measured and visually checked. Prefer c4 for complete base-to-crown visibility or c5 for a freely licensed portrait. Other candidates have base obstructions. Node downloads substituted for unavailable Python and failing curl TLS.
